excerpt.zh: 我们的量子弹弓的第一阶段已经完工。精确的扭力透镜装置正在从恒星中充能，这些能量可以剧烈地释放出来，将舰船传送至极远距离外。
excerpt.en: The first stage of our Quantum Catapult is now complete. A precise arrangement of torsion lenses gains charge from the star, and can release this energy in an erratic fashion to send ships across great distances.
